brief.problem: A regional distributor alternates between stockouts and excess inventory because sales overrides the forecast and suppliers have long, variable lead times.
brief.decision: Set the inventory policy and monthly demand-supply decision process for the next two quarters.
brief.context: Twelve thousand SKUs, seasonal demand, item-level history, supplier lead-time data, and three warehouses.
constraints: No warehouse-system replacement this year
Protect service on the highest-value items
brief.desired_output: Segmented inventory targets, a demand forecast process, decision cadence, and exception triggers.

brief.problem: A medical-device line has intermittent seal failures that escape final inspection, but leaders disagree about whether material, setup, or operator variation is responsible.
brief.decision: Choose the evidence sequence and controls that will reduce escapes without slowing every unit.
brief.context: Regulated assembly with timestamped process readings, lot genealogy, work instructions, and defect samples.
constraints: Maintain traceability
Do not redesign the entire line before isolating causes
brief.desired_output: Failure modes, causal tests, control limits, prevention actions, owners, and verification measures.

brief.problem: Two business-unit presidents may retire within eighteen months, internal successors are unclear, and the growth plan changes the capabilities those roles require.
brief.decision: Choose successor slates and development actions while deciding where an external search is necessary.
brief.context: Privately held industrial company with performance history but no current role profiles or calibrated talent review.
constraints: Keep the process confidential
Do not equate current performance with future-role readiness
brief.desired_output: Future role requirements, successor coverage, readiness gaps, development moves, and trigger dates.

brief.problem: Product teams have built 180 undocumented APIs with duplicate customer data, inconsistent authentication, and no owner for deprecation decisions.
brief.decision: Define the API operating model and architecture transition for the next year.
brief.context: Cloud software portfolio assembled through acquisitions with autonomous product teams.
constraints: No big-bang rewrite
Preserve critical partner integrations
brief.desired_output: API principles, ownership, lifecycle controls, target architecture, migration waves, and measures.

brief.problem: A ransomware event has taken order entry offline; backups exist but restore time is untested, customer communications are ad hoc, and plants can operate manually for only two days.
brief.decision: Stabilize the next 72 hours and establish recovery priorities before restoring systems.
brief.context: Multi-site manufacturer with an incident-response team, business owners, and third-party infrastructure support.
constraints: Do not reconnect unverified systems
Prioritize safety and order continuity
brief.desired_output: Crisis roles, business priorities, recovery sequence, communication cadence, and testable recovery objectives.

brief.problem: A new clinical scheduling workflow is technically live, but supervisors still permit spreadsheets and adoption varies sharply by clinic.
brief.decision: Choose the smallest set of behavior, leadership, and reinforcement interventions that will create reliable adoption in sixty days.
brief.context: Twenty clinics with usage logs, local champions, uneven training, and strong physician autonomy.
constraints: Do not relaunch the software
Respect clinical exceptions while ending convenience workarounds
brief.desired_output: Readiness barriers, stakeholder-specific interventions, reinforcement measures, and escalation triggers.

brief.problem: A food processor has $9 million for four mutually competing automation and energy projects whose benefits, timing, and risk profiles differ.
brief.decision: Select and stage the capital portfolio for next year's budget.
brief.context: Project cash flows are available but use inconsistent hurdle rates and optimism assumptions.
constraints: Stay within the capital ceiling
Show downside and dependency effects
brief.desired_output: Comparable project economics, sensitivity ranges, portfolio ranking, funding gates, and post-audit measures.

brief.problem: A holding company owns nine businesses with uneven market attractiveness, cash generation, competitive position, and parenting fit.
brief.decision: Choose where to invest, hold, harvest, partner, or exit over the next three years.
brief.context: Board strategy review with segment economics and market data but competing executive narratives.
constraints: Use explicit portfolio criteria
Separate business quality from corporate-owner advantage
brief.desired_output: Portfolio map, investment logic by business, parenting rationale, and decision gates.

brief.problem: A proven industrial sensor is ready for launch to a new buyer segment in the existing U.S. market, but positioning, channels, enablement, and launch ownership are unresolved.
brief.decision: Choose the target segment and launch plan for the next two quarters.
brief.context: Existing product, manufacturing capacity, pilot references, and a mixed direct-distributor sales model.
constraints: No new country entry
Launch only after segment and readiness gates clear
brief.desired_output: Target segment, positioning, channel plan, launch workstreams, readiness gates, and measures.

brief.problem: Customers begin insurance claims online, repeat information by phone, and cannot see status; internal teams optimize each channel separately.
brief.decision: Redesign the cross-channel claims experience and operating handoffs without replacing the core platform.
brief.context: Journey analytics, call recordings, customer interviews, and process data are available.
constraints: No core-platform replacement
Include customer and backstage operating changes
brief.desired_output: Current journey and service blueprint, failure points, future cross-channel design, owners, and pilot measures.

brief.problem: Enterprise sales representatives spend half their time on leads that never reach discovery, while marketing and sales disagree about what qualifies an account.
brief.decision: Redesign lead qualification, routing, and coaching for the next quarter.
brief.context: CRM history, campaign data, rep activity, stage conversion, and win-loss notes are available.
constraints: Start with interpretable rules before opaque automation
Measure both conversion and wasted effort
brief.desired_output: Lead score, funnel diagnosis, routing rules, sales behaviors, test design, and monitoring.

brief.problem: A subscription company must redesign three plan bundles, but leaders do not know which feature combinations customers value or how willingness to pay changes by segment.
brief.decision: Choose bundles and price ranges before a controlled market test.
brief.context: A customer panel can complete one survey; behavioral transaction data are limited.
constraints: Avoid asking customers to design the product directly
Estimate tradeoffs, not just stated importance
brief.desired_output: Attribute tradeoffs, segment-level preference estimates, price response, candidate bundles, and test plan.

brief.problem: A beverage company repeatedly misses seasonal demand because promotions, weather, distribution expansion, and stockouts distort the raw history.
brief.decision: Set the next twelve-month baseline forecast and an override process that can be audited.
brief.context: Weekly item-region history with promotion calendars, weather, availability, and planned distribution changes.
constraints: Quantify forecast uncertainty
Do not treat constrained sales as unconstrained demand
brief.desired_output: Forecast model, causal adjustments, accuracy backtest, uncertainty range, and override governance.

brief.problem: A manufacturer buys a critical molded component from forty suppliers using unit price as the main criterion despite quality, freight, tooling, and disruption differences.
brief.decision: Choose the sourcing strategy and supplier shortlist for the next contract cycle.
brief.context: Spend, defect, delivery, tooling, freight, and supplier-risk data are available.
constraints: Avoid a lowest-bid-only decision
Preserve dual-source resilience for critical parts
brief.desired_output: Category strategy, total-cost comparison, supplier segmentation, negotiation priorities, and award gates.

brief.problem: A shared-services group allocates overhead by revenue, making simple high-volume customers look unprofitable and hiding expensive exception work.
brief.decision: Redesign cost attribution and choose which process costs to remove before changing customer terms.
brief.context: General ledger, time samples, transaction volumes, exception counts, and customer-level revenue are available.
constraints: Separate cost diagnosis from across-the-board cuts
Make drivers maintainable
brief.desired_output: Activity map, cost-driver model, customer economics, priority waste, and management actions.

brief.problem: A construction program has approved drawings but receives weekly scope requests without quantified schedule, cost, or safety effects.
brief.decision: Establish a decision process for pending and future changes while protecting the completion date.
brief.context: Multiple contractors, a fixed opening date, fragmented issue logs, and an executive steering group.
constraints: No informal scope approvals
Urgent safety changes need a fast path
brief.desired_output: Change intake, impact analysis, approval thresholds, decision rights, integrated risk log, and audit trail.

brief.problem: Data scientists deploy credit-risk models by emailing notebooks to engineers; training data, tests, approvals, and production drift are not reproducible.
brief.decision: Define the governed model-delivery lifecycle for the next two releases.
brief.context: Regulated lender with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, a model-risk committee, and an existing security team.
constraints: Retain independent model approval
Automate evidence without bypassing controls
brief.desired_output: Lifecycle stages, artifacts, deployment controls, ownership, monitoring, rollback, and audit evidence.

brief.problem: A signed acquisition combines a process-driven company with a founder-led creative firm; key talent may leave and leadership norms conflict.
brief.decision: Choose the Day 1 and first-100-day people-integration approach without erasing the acquired firm's differentiating culture.
brief.context: Leadership interviews, engagement data, retention agreements, org charts, and deal rationale are available.
constraints: Do not force uniformity where it destroys value
Name decisions that must be settled before Day 1
brief.desired_output: Culture risks, integration principles, decision rights, retention actions, communication, and early indicators.

brief.problem: A family-owned wholesaler will breach a debt covenant in six weeks and cannot cover both a balloon payment and seasonal inventory without new terms.
brief.decision: Choose the lender proposal and near-term cash actions before the covenant breach.
brief.context: Thirteen-week receipts and disbursements, collateral, debt documents, supplier terms, and base/downside sales cases are available.
constraints: Preserve going-concern value
Do not promise repayment unsupported by cash timing
brief.desired_output: Liquidity bridge, restructuring options, lender case, trigger points, concessions, and contingency actions.

brief.problem: A board memo contains forty pages of analysis but does not make the recommendation, governing logic, or requested decision clear.
brief.decision: Restructure the communication for a fifteen-minute board discussion and explicit vote.
brief.context: The underlying analysis is complete and defensible; the failure is synthesis and decision communication.
constraints: Do not add another research workstream
Lead with the answer and preserve the critical evidence trail
brief.desired_output: Governing recommendation, supporting argument hierarchy, concise situation-complication logic, and decision ask.

brief.problem: Engagement fell in two functions after a hybrid-work change, but leaders are treating the company-wide average as one problem.
brief.decision: Identify the employee segments and managerial conditions that require different interventions.
brief.context: Two years of survey items, comments, manager spans, turnover, absence, promotion, and location data are available.
constraints: Protect respondent confidentiality
Do not infer causality from correlation alone
brief.desired_output: Segmented evidence, drivers and alternative explanations, manager-level actions, and follow-up measures.

brief.problem: A packaged-goods company wants to cut packaging waste and emissions, but teams propose recyclable labels, material reduction, refill, and supplier changes without a shared boundary.
brief.decision: Choose a two-year packaging circularity portfolio and supplier requirements.
brief.context: Material bills, supplier data, waste audits, logistics impacts, and customer research are available with some lifecycle gaps.
constraints: Avoid burden shifting between carbon and waste
Pilot uncertain consumer behaviors before scale
brief.desired_output: System boundary, material and emissions baseline, circular options, supplier actions, portfolio priorities, and tests.

brief.problem: A bank sees low adoption of a new small-business cash tool, while surveys say customers want it and product teams debate adding features.
brief.decision: Determine the real customer job and why behavior contradicts stated demand before choosing a product change.
brief.context: Usage data, support contacts, sales interviews, and access to customers in their workplaces are available.
constraints: Observe actual work, not only opinions
Do not commit a roadmap before the job and friction are validated
brief.desired_output: Customer job, contextual evidence, competing explanations, behavioral friction, and a falsifiable product test.

brief.problem: A packaging line loses twelve percent of planned time to recurring micro-stops, reactive maintenance, and changeover failures with no shared loss taxonomy.
brief.decision: Choose the maintenance and operating system changes that will raise reliable equipment availability over ninety days.
brief.context: Machine alarms, maintenance work orders, shift logs, spare-parts history, and operator observations are available.
constraints: No new line purchase
Separate chronic loss from one-time breakdowns
brief.desired_output: Loss baseline, failure modes, maintenance priorities, operator routines, visual measures, and verification cadence.
